script_text: A seismic shift disrupts Cancer’s emotional equilibrium this week. Early Monday, Mercury trine your natal Moon in the 10th House boosts career focus, while Wednesday’s Sun square Saturn in the 4th tests resilience; Monday and Tuesday are best for bold moves, Thursday worst due to friction. On Thursday, the Moon enters your 6th House, pivoting your daily routines. Later, Venus trine Neptune in the 2nd enhances finances, and Mars in the 7th sparks passionate love connections. Wednesday is your power day because the Sun activates your 4th House of roots. Friday brings luck in collaborative ventures. Focus on grounding emotions to stabilize your Water element ruled by the Moon. Follow for daily updates.
